settings.privacy_body_1: Mālama ʻia nā kī API ma kāu pūnaewele (localStorage) a hoʻouna ʻia wale i ka API o ka mea hoʻolako AI — ʻaʻole i kekahi kikowaena ʻē aʻe. Hiki iā ʻoe ke holoi iā lākou i kēlā me kēia manawa.
settings.privacy_body_2: Mālama kēia polokalamu i ʻeono mau mea ma localStorage: ka makemake ʻano nānāhiʻo, ka makemake ʻōlelo, ka laina paepae, ka hoʻonohonoho huli ola, ka mea hoʻolako AI, a me nā kī API. ʻAʻohe ʻikepili ʻē aʻe e mālama ʻia a hoʻouna ʻia paha.
settings.privacy_body_translations: Ua hana ʻia nā unuhi o ka pūnaewele a me ka corpus e AI a hiki ke loaʻa nā kuhi hewa. ʻAʻole hoʻouna ʻia nā ʻikepili pilikino o ka mea hoʻohana no ka unuhi.
settings.reduced_motion_note: Ua hōʻā ʻoe i ka hōʻemi neʻe a ke ʻike ana mākou i ia hoʻonohonoho. E ʻaluʻalu ʻia ana nā hoʻoneʻe e like me ka confetti a hiki i kāu hoʻololi ʻana ma nā hoʻonohonoho kōkua o kāu ʻōnaehana hana.

party.announce_full: Ua hoʻā ʻia ke ʻano pāʻina! Ua loli ka hua palapala i Comic Sans. Ua loli nā waihoʻoluʻu i kahi papa waihoʻoluʻu ʻōlinolino ʻōpiopio. Ke haule nei nā confetti waihoʻoluʻu mai luna o ka pale i nā waihoʻoluʻu a me nā hiʻohiʻona like ʻole. He koolau kupanaha ka iʻoa ʻumeke i kēia manawa.
party.announce_reduced: Ua hoʻā ʻia ke ʻano pāʻina! Ua loli ka hua palapala i Comic Sans. Ua loli nā waihoʻoluʻu i kahi papa waihoʻoluʻu ʻōlinolino ʻōpiopio. He koolau kupanaha ka iʻoa ʻumeke i kēia manawa. Ua ʻaluʻalu ʻia nā confetti no ka mea ua hoʻā ʻia ka hōʻemi neʻe.

header.open_about: E pili ana i kēia polokalamu
about.what_body: He kōkua kākau no ka loiloi kūpono. E huli i ka hale waihona o nā wehewehe hewa i pili i WCAG, koho i ka mea e kūpono ana i kāu loiloi, hoʻololi a kope pololei i loko o kāu hōʻike.
about.what_wcag: Coverage extends up to WCAG 2.2 (Level A and AA) across both web and native app contexts.
about.step_1_body: E paʻi i kāu mea i ʻike ʻia — inoa o ka mea hana, ʻano ʻano, a i ʻole wehewehe maʻamau.
about.step_2_body: Use the Priority Up/Priority Down arrows on each result to tune how results are ranked. Star to show first. Archive to hide it.
about.step_3_body: E hoʻohui i kahi hoʻomaka (p.d. "Āpau:") a hoʻohana i ke kahua AI hoʻomāikaʻi e hoʻololi i ka ʻōlelo.
about.step_4_body: Add a location prefix (e.g. "Global:") or use AI to help revise the wording.
about.feature_ai_body: E hoʻomāikaʻi i kekahi wehewehe hewa me ka memo pōkole. Kāu kī API, kāu mea hoʻolako AI — ʻaʻole mālama ʻia ma ka server.
about.feature_languages_body: Loaʻa ka UI ma luna o 50 mau ʻōlelo me ka RTL. E hoʻololi ma nā hoʻonohonoho.
about.feature_party_body: Aia ma nā hoʻonohonoho. Ma lalo o ka ʻano. ʻIke ʻoe i ka ʻike ʻana.
about.feature_a11y_body: Kūkulu ʻia e like me WCAG 2.2: hoʻomalu focus, wahi ola, hoʻokele kibord, neʻe ʻemi, a me nā hōʻailona kiʻekiʻe.
about.coming_auth: E komo koho me Google a i ʻole GitHub e hoʻonohonoho i kāu mau hoʻonohonoho ma nā mea.
about.coming_custom: E hoʻohui a hoʻoponopono i kāu mau hewa pilikino, mālama ʻia ma ka cloud.
about.coming_ai: Nā mea hoʻolako AI hou: OpenAI, Google Gemini, a me nā mea hou.
